<div id="col-1236412585" class="col small-12 large-12" >
<div class="col-inner" >

<div id="text-1728737482" class="text">

<h1><span style="color: #ffffff;">Serviços executados</span></h1>
<p><span style="color: #ffffff;">Reforma RSVP 2</span></p>
<p><span style="color: #ffffff;">PROJETO: Jóia Bergamo </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #ffffff;">Engenharia Civil: Brooks Construtora </span></p>
<p><span style="color: #ffffff;">Reforma completa de apartamento de 270m2.</span></p>
<style>
#text-1728737482 {
text-align: left;
}
</style>
</div>
<div class="row align-equal" id="row-2123600765">


<div id="col-2028115409" class="col medium-4 small-12 large-12" >
<div class="col-inner" >

<div id="text-4086386238" class="text">

<p><span style="font-size: 120%; color: #000000;"><strong>Serviços executados pela Brooks Construtora:</strong></span></p>
<ol>
